I replied in #inc-vtg-hartford.

You first reported the kiosks offline at 10:42 AM on 3 Aug. At that point the guard was writing trailer numbers on a clipboard. Mateo's 10:44 AM message says six trucks were waiting at the east gate. Kiosk 1 came back at 11:03 AM, when the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch saw it. You confirmed both lanes working at 11:07 AM.
